name: HYPROMELLOSE 0.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION 15 ML 1 PIECE
description: What pain does lysine clonixinate relieve? It is indicated as an analgesic and anti-inflammatory in patients with acute or chronic pain. It is also indicated for soft tissue conditions, headaches, ear pain, sinusitis, and herpes zoster. It is also indicated for gynecological, orthopedic, urological, and general surgical pain and procedures. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
